work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CVIII, on Cardinal Pedicini’s visitation report, separates the S. Bartolomeo all’Isola missionary college from the Roman province, subjects it to the Observant vicar general, removes the philosophy course and imposes common life; the act extends beyond the raw heading frame LF20498–20512 through LF20758; LF20582 → LF20588 across page number 139 LF20585; LF20654 → LF20658 across page number 140 LF20657; LF20718 → LF20724 across running title LF20721; complete 19 August 1836 closing. Own provenance LF20444 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF20521–20521; the source closing at LF20755–20758 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona au- gusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo sexto, pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
